report:
Resume of change stream was not possible, as the resume point may no longer be in the oplog.

Hi,
For my mongodb source connect cluster was shut down last night. This morning upon restarting the connect cluster, one of my mongodb connector failed with error:
`Resume of change stream was not possible, as the resume point may no longer be in the oplog.`
As the documentation suggests, I removed the offset and restarted the connector. Yet I am getting the same error on restart.

evidence.quote: but the key is different, yo you have not overwritten the old one." Reporter: "It is resolved, thanks!

notes: Connector kept failing after 'removing' offsets, looking like it ignored the reset; the tombstone was written under a different offset key. Offset key format settles it.
